{
"meetingId": "199",
"tickets": [
{
"templateId": "ef69e24e-b352-50b8-81a8-9d4035bd97bf",
"title": "Coordinate business sale planning handoff",
"text": "Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle and attorney Celia Nettlewhisk. Coordinate these items for Serena Cloudpuddle ahead of the August 2 deadline.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-08-02",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02."
},
{
"templateId": "d71226e6-275a-5a53-88b4-57b55eccb19c",
"title": "Liquidity Reserve Snapshot",
"text": "Calculate a cash reserve for Serena Cloudpuddle that covers monthly spending, projected tax liabilities, mortgage payments, upcoming school expenses, and support for her mother, based on the anticipated $3.8 million sale proceeds. Use the August 9 deadline to finalize the reserve size.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "the income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Coordinate post‑closing tax estimate with CPA",
"text": "Coordinate with Serena Cloudpuddle’s CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle to obtain a post‑closing tax estimate, as required by the August 16 deadline.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-08-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain executed sale documentation and wire instructions",
"text": "Obtain from Serena Cloudpuddle the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire instruction evidence required for the sale, to be completed by July 31.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-07-31",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Sale documentation remains needed by 2024-07-31 because only a summary term sheet was available, not the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, or wire instruction evidence."
},
{
"templateId": "14e5989f-674d-5715-91ad-e38bb23e715b",
"title": "Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps",
"text": "Request Serena Cloudpuddle's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Complete this review for Serena Cloudpuddle by August 23, noting that no current signed trust, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records were on file after the recent business valuation change.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-08-23",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Request and log estate documents",
"text": "Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "dc27a56a-9f8e-5909-959b-cf89e9c02e33"
},
{
"title": "Review completeness and role information",
"text": "Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "a7eb678b-bf5e-50fc-b01b-eeb80d99a3e0"
},
{
"title": "Prepare advisor gap summary",
"text": "Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "91e6fcb2-95ab-5fbf-b81c-989b1748ccb3"
}
],
"evidence": "an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23."
}
]
